objectives.description: Write per-linter table to progress notes; STOP if simpNF/dupNamespace non-zero
objectives.note: simpNF=1 (NON-ZERO). Finding is FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability.length_range_map at BiLasso/Extraction.lean:97 -- 'simp can prove this: by simp only [*, @List.length_map, @List.length_range]'. This is UNRELATED to the D-01 mutually-inverse-pair loop (confirmed dead by objective 5's smoke test). CORRECTION (made during Phase 2, 2026-09-04): the original entry here claimed dupNamespace=0 based on lake exe runLinter's silence. That was WRONG. dupNamespace is a compile-time TEXT linter (Mathlib.Tactic.Linter.Lint, register_option linter.dupNamespace), not part of runLinter's Batteries @[env_linter]/#lint batch family at all -- it never appears in that tool's output regardless of its true count. Measured correctly via `lake lint --builtin-only --lint-only .dupNamespace`: 14 real findings, all in FormalSystem/Metalogic/BXCanonical/Chronicle/ChronicleTypes.lean (`structure Chronicle where` nested inside `namespace ...Chronicle`, double-namespacing every field/projection: `.dom`, `.f`, `.mk`, `.g`, `.c0`..`.c5'`). Pre-existing, unrelated to task 529. Full unnarrowed driver census (== plain `lake lint`, exactly what CI's `lint: true` with empty lint-args invokes): 307 errors -- defsWithUnderscore=33, docBlame=51, simpNF=1, structureInType=1, tacticDocs=4, unusedArguments=217 -- confirmed via `runLinter.lean` source read that the driver's CLI has no linter-narrowing flag at all (getChecks (slow := true) (runAlways := none) (runOnly := none)), so no lint-args string can narrow the driver's own batch below 307. dupNamespace's 14 findings are Lean `warning:`-severity (not errors) and never reach the driver at all, confirmed absent from every plain `lake lint`/`runLinter` run. RESOLVED (updated after Phase 2 completed): `scripts/nolints.json` grandfathering (Batteries/Mathlib's standard mechanism, confirmed present in runLinter.lean, read unconditionally on every run) supersedes Contingency #3 entirely. Generated via `lake exe runLinter --update FormalSystem`, it grandfathers the 307 pre-existing env_linter findings; plain `lake lint` (CI's exact invocation) now exits 0. `lint: true` landed in ci.yml with no `lint-args` -- the plan's actual Goal is achieved, via a better mechanism than the lint-args narrowing the plan originally sketched (the full env_linter set stays live as a regression gate rather than being permanently reduced to two linters). See Phase 2 progress (objective 9) for the full sequence. Neither simpNF's 1 finding nor dupNamespace's 14 findings needed fixing to reach this outcome -- both remain recorded (simpNF in nolints.json; dupNamespace unaffected, since it never reaches the driver) as a follow-up-task worklist rather than blockers.
